prompt: The video begins with a serene sunset at Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, where the camera captures the sun dipping into the horizon, casting a warm orange glow across the calm waters. The camera slowly pans from left to right, revealing scattered rocks along the shoreline and the gentle waves lapping against them. As the scene transitions, the camera moves inland, showcasing a sandy beach bordered by dense foliage and large boulders. The camera continues its steady forward motion, entering a forested area with tall trees and underbrush, the dimming light creating deep shadows among the leaves. The path becomes more defined as the camera follows a wooden walkway through the woods, the camera angle slightly tilted upward to capture the towering trees overhead. The sky, partially obscured by clouds, allows glimpses of the fading sunlight, adding a soft, diffused light to the scene. The camera then focuses on a set of wooden stairs leading upwards, the surrounding vegetation thickening as the camera ascends, capturing the intricate details of the forest floor and the interplay of light and shadow. The entire sequence maintains a tranquil and immersive atmosphere, emphasizing the natural beauty and solitude of the location during the quiet moments of sunset.
